predictor.notes: Retained unchanged: additional exact requests at quantities 250, 600 and 750 were denied; repeated estimates at 500 and 900 were unchanged. The predictor reproduces both observed exact prices—68,387 pence at quantity 50 and 127,037 pence at quantity 200—and all 16 catalogue estimates under nearest-10,000-pence rounding. Predictions are positive and nondecreasing throughout 1..1000. Alternative models with early quadratic curvature or a later plateau also match every observation while differing by thousands of pence, so the new investigation does not support selecting a more accurate reconstruction. These segments approximate a regularized average of compatible decreasing-marginal-rate models, not verified tariff bands. Only quantities 50 and 200 were observed exactly; all other prices remain model-dependent, without a certified error bound. Cumulative usage: 39 business requests and 5 REA operations.
